```{R}
library(tidyverse)
library(gridExtra)
```

```{R}
file_name <- "/Volumes/MMMICovid/fcamagli/RESULTS/household-epidemics/output/model-halloween/thermo-integr/validate.csv"
setup_file_name <- "/Volumes/MMMICovid/fcamagli/RESULTS/household-epidemics/parameters/setup.csv"
params_file_name <- "/Volumes/MMMICovid/fcamagli/RESULTS/household-epidemics/output/model-halloween/thermo-integr/parameters.csv"

# Load parameters data
if (is.null(params_file_name)) {
  target <- list()
} else {
  params <- read.csv(params_file_name, sep = ",", header = FALSE, row.names = 1)
  target <- as.list(params$V2)
}

# Load setup data
if (is.null(setup_file_name)) {
  num_adapt_iter <- 0
  burn_in <- 0
} else {
  # Read setup file
  setup <- read.csv(setup_file_name, sep = ",", header = FALSE, row.names = 1)

  # Extract values
  num_adapt_iter <- as.integer(setup["num_adapt_iter", ])
  burn_in <- num_adapt_iter
}

# Load results data
results <- read.csv(file_name, sep = ",")
df <- results[results["iter"] > num_adapt_iter + burn_in, ]

cols <- colnames(df)
cols <- cols[cols != "iter"]
cols <- cols[!grepl("__a", cols)]

thinning <- df[["iter"]][2] - df[["iter"]][1]
N <- length(df[["iter"]])
```

```{R}
# Define a custom theme
custom_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
  )

# Set the custom theme as the default theme for all plots
theme_set(custom_theme)

plot_list <- list()
for (p in cols) {
  # plot Monte Carlo Markov Chain
  plot_list[[p]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = iter, y = .data[[p]])) + 
  geom_line()

  # plot histogram of values
  plot_list[[paste0(p,"p-hist")]] <- ggplot(df, aes(y = .data[[p]])) +
  geom_density()
}

arranged_plots <- grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = 2)
```
